name: Semantic-Entropy Escalation Council
description: Blueprint 18 of 96 (design card BP-CNC-03, 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md:958). MECHANISM: replace a human eyeballing three opinions with a NUMBER and a FIXED rule. Answers from >=3 independent models are clustered semantically, an entropy is computed, and the accept/escalate decision is taken deterministically against a threshold that was committed BEFORE any answer was seen. Two refusals are load-bearing: fewer than three answers means the gate REFUSES rather than computing a meaningless entropy, and low entropy across same-family models raises a correlated-blind-spot warning because agreement is not truth. This is the only blueprint in the range that does not loop and does not fan out - the design card says the gate takes ONE decision per invocation - and the only one with fully deterministic replay.

question.description: The question the model answers were produced for

model_answers.description: Already-collected answers. Fewer than three is a refusal, not a degraded run: entropy over two points is undefined in any useful sense.

entropy_threshold.description: Normalised semantic entropy above which the run ESCALATES. Committed and hashed BEFORE any answer is read - a threshold chosen after seeing the answers is not a threshold.

escalation_target.description: Where an ESCALATE decision routes. The design card prefers a debate over simply adding a fourth model.

clustering_seed.description: Seed for the semantic clustering, so replay is byte-reproducible

threshold-committer.description: Writes and hashes the threshold BEFORE any answer is read; holds no opinion on the question

clusterer.description: Runs the deterministic semantic clustering and entropy computation; reports the number and never interprets it

independence-auditor.description: Audits whether the answers are actually INDEPENDENT - same-family models agreeing confidently and wrongly is the failure this role exists to catch

owner.description: The human owner - the escalation destination of last resort

stages.title: S0a COMMIT the threshold and hash it BEFORE any answer is read

work_unit.title: Commit and hash the entropy threshold before reading any answer
work_unit.question_or_target: Write the threshold, the escalation target and the clustering seed to disk and hash them, recording that no answer content has been read yet.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: trivial work, but it must happen first or the whole gate is post-hoc

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the commit records a sha256 over threshold plus seed plus escalation target, and asserts answers_read == 0 at write time, so a later-chosen threshold is mechanically detectable
tests_required: a threshold written after answers were read must FAIL the precommit gate
both-states control: run the ordering check with the commit AFTER the collect stage and confirm it FAILS; run it before and confirm it PASSES
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the independence auditor confirms the commit hash matches the threshold actually used in the routing decision
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0301 emitted when threshold-commit.json exists, parses, and records the hash plus answers_read == 0; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0301 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - a re-commit after answers were read is exactly the defect this unit prevents; restart the invocation instead

stages.title: S0b The threshold must be pre-committed or this workflow measures nothing
S0c COLLECT the answers and audit whether they are actually independent

work_unit.title: Normalise the answer set and build the independence matrix over its producers
work_unit.question_or_target: Normalise every supplied answer, count distinct vendors and model families, and state for each pair whether the two producers are mechanically independent.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: independence is the assumption the entropy number rests on; auditing it is not a cheap step

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the matrix names the mechanism that makes each pair independent (different vendor, different family, different prompt) - a pair with no named mechanism is recorded as CORRELATED, not assumed independent
tests_required: three answers from one vendor must set distinct_vendors == 1 and fail the enough-independent-answers gate
two answers must fail the gate rather than yielding an entropy
both-states control: feed 3 same-vendor answers (expect FAIL) and 3 cross-vendor answers (expect PASS)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the clusterer refuses to run if the answer set reports zero named independence mechanisms
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0302 emitted when answer-set.json exists, parses, and every producer pair carries an independence verdict; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0302 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on too-few-answers - that is an input shortfall the caller must fix, not a transient failure

stages.title: S0d REFUSE rather than compute a meaningless entropy
S1-S2 CLUSTER semantically and COMPUTE the entropy - deterministic given the answer set

work_unit.title: Cluster the answers semantically and compute the normalised entropy
work_unit.question_or_target: Cluster answers by meaning under the committed seed and compute the normalised semantic entropy over the cluster distribution.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the clustering is itself a model, which is the honest weakness of this blueprint; the seed makes it at least reproducible

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the artifact records the cluster assignment per answer, the seed used, and the exact command that produced the number - so the same inputs re-run to the same entropy and a divergence is detectable
tests_required: three identical answers must give entropy near zero
three mutually contradictory answers must give a high entropy
two identical plus one different must land on a documented, stable side of the threshold
re-running with the same seed must reproduce the entropy byte-for-byte
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the independence auditor re-runs the computation once with the same seed and confirms hash equality
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0303 emitted when entropy.json exists, parses, records the seed and the per-answer cluster assignment, and the re-run hash matches; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0303 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry on a transient tool failure; a non-reproducible entropy is a detector failure and escalates rather than retrying

stages.title: S2b Low entropy across same-family models is NOT independence - raise the warning

work_unit.title: Raise a correlated-blind-spot warning when agreement comes from correlated producers
work_unit.question_or_target: If the entropy is low, state whether the agreeing answers came from mechanically independent producers, and raise a correlated-blind-spot warning where they did not.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: this is the only thing standing between a low number and a false sense of settledness

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the warning names WHICH producer pairs are correlated and by what mechanism; a low entropy with no correlated pairs records an explicit NO-WARNING rather than an empty file
tests_required: three same-family answers agreeing must produce a WARNING even though entropy is near zero
both-states control: the warning must FIRE on a same-family agreeing set and stay SILENT on a cross-vendor agreeing set - a warning that fires in both states measures nothing
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reader confirms the warning is absent only where a named independence mechanism exists for every agreeing pair
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WCNC-0304 emitted when blindspot-warning.json exists and parses, carrying either named correlated pairs or an explicit NO-WARNING; otherwise FAILED:WCNC-0304 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: record the warning as UNKNOWN rather than asserting independence that was not established

stages.title: S3 ROUTE deterministically against the pre-committed threshold - ACCEPT or ESCALATE, one decision, no loop

impact.blast_radius: writes only under command-center/entropy/bp-cnc-03/**; no network; the routing decision is advisory until a caller acts on it

x_extensions.distinct_mechanism: a pre-committed and hashed threshold, a refusal below three independent answers, a seeded reproducible entropy, a purely deterministic ACCEPT/ESCALATE route, and a correlated-blind-spot warning - with no loop and no fan-out anywhere in the document
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-CNC-07 resolves a split by READING THE PROBES and never computes a dispersion number; this measures DISPERSION and never inspects a probe. BP-CNC-02 makes the models interact; this never does - it consumes answers that already exist. It is the only blueprint in the range with replay.deterministic == true and retry strategy none.
contraindications: a single model - entropy is undefined
free-form essay answers - semantic clustering degrades and the number stops meaning anything
use as a correctness oracle - low entropy means agreement, NOT truth

worked_examples.name: three cross-vendor answers that genuinely disagree

params.question: How many distinct output_schema paths does the work-unit catalog declare

model_answers.answer: about 250, the reference count is unclear

worked_examples.walkthrough: S0a hashes threshold 0.35 with seed 20260810 and records answers_read == 0. S0b passes. S0c finds 3 answers from 3 distinct vendors and names the independence mechanism for each pair. S0d passes. S1-S2 cluster into three singleton clusters, giving normalised entropy 1.0. S2b raises NO-WARNING: the producers are genuinely independent, so the disagreement is real information rather than an artifact. S3 routes ESCALATE (1.0 > 0.35) to the probe-wins resolver - which is the correct destination, because this is a FACTUAL question and dispersion cannot settle it. Note what the blueprint does NOT do: it does not pick 234 because two answers are numerically closer. That is the whole point of routing rather than judging.

expected_gate_outcomes.threshold-precommitted: PASS - hash recorded, answers_read == 0 at write time

worked_examples.name: negative control - three same-vendor answers agreeing

params.question: How many distinct output_schema paths does the catalog declare

worked_examples.walkthrough: Entropy would be near zero and a naive gate would ACCEPT 269 - which is the WRONG number (the measured value is 234). distinct_vendors == 1 fails enough-independent-answers with on_fail=fail, so no entropy is ever computed. Had the set slipped through, S2b would still raise a correlated-blind-spot warning naming all three pairs as same-vendor. This is the design card's standing warning made mechanical: agreement among same-family models is not independence, and this is the one case where a low number is most dangerous.

benchmark_cases: two identical plus one different -> the threshold behaviour must be documented and stable
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED threshold calibration on this estate. Settling experiment: replay 20 past multi-model answer sets whose ground truth is now known and pick the threshold that maximises correct escalation. Confidence that the tool exists: almost-certain (90-99%); that the default threshold is right without calibration: likely (55-80%).
x_extensions.owner_decision: OPEN (design card BP-CNC-03): calibrate the entropy threshold on replayed history before use, or ship the tool's default and tune on incidents? This blueprint is executable either way - entropy_threshold is a param with a default, and the precommit gate makes whichever choice is made auditable.
